charts.title: The sepsis core — one spec, real output under the exact SBML engine
charts.caption: Real output of the one sepsis spec under the exact Tellurium/roadrunner engine (real_trajectories.json): four observables over 48 h at healthy baseline vs severe sepsis. The severe run drops MAP to 69 mmHg (below the 65 shock line) and tissue integrity to 0.32 as blood pathogen climbs — the physiology the whole investigation studies.
